source_policy: Structured facts are paraphrased from the public research corpus; records remain partially verified until reconciled against first-party/in-game evidence.

records.name: Kamehameha
records.source: Parallel Quest 5 "Saiyan Blood"; TP Medal Shop rotations
records.mechanics: Chargeable three-stage Ki Blast beam; strongest close-range hit count at full charge; transformed use can re-aim toward a dodging target.

records.name: Quick Sleep
records.source: Skill Shop after the Warrior from the Demon World story saga; TP Medal rotations
records.mechanics: Hold to sleep and recover Health; the user is defenseless during the animation. Purification can extend the recovery package to Ki and Stamina.

records.name: Saiyan Blaster
records.source: Conton City Patrol / Teach Me, Broly! (Part 2)
records.mechanics: Creates a protective aura barrier and allows immediate activation of an Awoken Skill while the aura is active.

records.name: Gigantic Cluster
records.source: Parallel Quest 163 "Broly the Invader"; Ultimate Finish reward slot
records.mechanics: Scatter barrage of green Ki Blasts; blast count increases while an Awoken Skill is active.

records.name: Remote Serious Bomb
records.source: Extra Story completion; TP Medal rotations
records.mechanics: First activation marks and seals the target's Awoken Skill; a second activation produces and launches the Serious Bomb while the seal is active.

records.name: Impulse Slash
records.mechanics: Long rush sequence ending in an energy-blast finisher; when used with an Awoken Skill active, guarded hits drain additional Stamina.
